hypotheses.claim: NOT IN over a subquery forces a null-aware anti join, which is expensive. (matched: not in (select t.ratecodeid from lake.trips t where t.pulocationid = z.locationid) order b)

The LEFT_DELIM_JOIN (node 5) implements NOT IN with nullable RatecodeID/PULocationID, which disables the anti-join optimization and requires per-zone evaluation of the correlated subquery instead of a single anti-hash join.
The outer HASH_JOIN (node 6) builds a hash table from the trips scan for each zone row, causing 265 separate hash builds over ~495k rows rather than a single shared structure.
The SEQ_SCAN on trips (node 8) reads all 495k rows with no predicate pushdown of the correlated PULocationID = z.LocationID, because the correlation is resolved upstream in the DELIM_JOIN machinery.
